title: UROP — Undergraduate Research Opportunities Program (MIT)
pi_name: Find ProjectsApply Online Once you find your UROP
description:
UROP is MIT's flagship undergraduate research program — running since 1969, it cultivates research partnerships between undergraduates and faculty in every department, year-round, for pay, academic credit, or as a volunteer. Most MIT students do at least one UROP; students propose a project directly with a supervisor or answer posted openings.
